answer: In an education-credential agent economy, each agent stakes a bonded identity whose reputation is anchored to a verifiable learning transcript, so a single honest actor cannot cheaply spawn a plume of puppet accounts. New agents must first complete a costly proctored assessment within a licensed oasis of trusted issuers, and their stake is weighted by a yarrow-like. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
